sample.description: division announcements, logit on the choice between equity spin-off and captive spin-off

findings: parents overvalued relative to their industry, or whose new company's industry is overvalued, more often choose the captive form
high-growth, low-profitability parents with financing needs more often choose the captive form
announcement CAR of equity spin-offs significantly exceeds that of captive spin-offs; highest for undervalued parents choosing the equity form
